text:
### Disaster Recovery Testing  
**Frequency:** Quarterly (at least)  
**Test Scenarios:**
- Database restoration from backup
- Application failover to standby region
- Network failure simulation
- Data loss scenario  
---
name: Chunk 30/39

raw_entities.name: Disaster Recovery Testing Frequency
raw_entities.description: The required frequency for conducting disaster recovery tests across FirstUK Bank's critical systems and infrastructure. Testing must occur at least quarterly to ensure readiness and validate recovery procedures.

raw_entities.name: Database Restoration from Backup
raw_entities.description: A mandatory disaster recovery test scenario requiring the bank to validate its ability to restore database systems from backup media. This ensures data integrity and recovery time objectives are met during actual disaster events.

raw_entities.name: Application Failover to Standby Region
raw_entities.description: A critical disaster recovery test scenario validating the bank's ability to automatically or manually switch application processing from the primary region to a geographically separate standby region. This ensures business continuity during regional outages.

raw_entities.name: Network Failure Simulation
raw_entities.description: A disaster recovery test scenario that simulates network connectivity failures to validate system resilience and failover mechanisms. This ensures the bank can maintain critical operations during network outages.

raw_entities.name: Data Loss Scenario
raw_entities.description: A disaster recovery test scenario simulating catastrophic data loss to validate backup integrity, recovery procedures, and the bank's ability to restore critical data within acceptable recovery time objectives.
